description: Scope-gated Linear project administration with optional GitHub and Obsidian evidence adapters
name: org.openlyuseful/linear-project

environmentVariables.description: Linear API key. Configure this or LINEAR_ACCESS_TOKEN through a protected secret store.
environmentVariables.name: LINEAR_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Linear OAuth access token. Configure this or LINEAR_API_KEY through a protected secret store.
environmentVariables.name: LINEAR_ACCESS_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Exact Linear organization ID allowed for scoped operations.
environmentVariables.name: LINEAR_ALLOWED_ORGANIZATION_ID

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated exact Linear team IDs. Required when reusing an existing team; leave empty only while bootstrapping a new dedicated team.
environmentVariables.name: LINEAR_ALLOWED_TEAM_IDS

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated exact Linear project IDs. Required after project discovery; leave empty only during initial bootstrap.
environmentVariables.name: LINEAR_ALLOWED_PROJECT_IDS

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated exact scope codes. Leave empty for read-only capability inspection.
environmentVariables.name: LINEAR_ALLOWED_SCOPE_CODES

environmentVariables.description: Optional GitHub token used only by the read-only evidence adapter.
environmentVariables.name: GITHUB_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated owner/repository allowlist for GitHub evidence reads.
environmentVariables.name: GITHUB_ALLOWED_REPOSITORIES

environmentVariables.description: Optional normalized absolute path to an Obsidian vault.
environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_VAULT_PATH

environmentVariables.description: Optional expected Obsidian vault directory name.
environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_VAULT_NAME

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated vault-relative directories allowed for Obsidian operations.
environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_ALLOWED_DIRECTORIES

environmentVariables.description: Global mutation gate. Keep false unless opening a separately bounded write window.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_WRITES_ENABLED

environmentVariables.description: Future RFC3339 expiry for a write window; enabled windows may last at most 60 minutes.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_WRITE_WINDOW_EXPIRES_AT

environmentVariables.description: Optional normalized absolute path for the append-only NDJSON operation audit.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUDIT_LOG_PATH

title: Linear Project
